# Development Report

## Delivery Context

Target Milestone: Personal reading list MVP

Current Increment: Increment 1 - Capture books

## Implemented Scope

- Add a book with a required title.
- View all captured books in insertion order.

## Deferred Accepted Scope

- Mark a book as read or unread.
- Filter the list by reading status.

These capabilities belong to Increment 2 - Reading progress.

## Result

Increment 1 implementation completed and was handed to Validation.
